request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:FARM

layers.text: Turn each of the three raised beds of soil into a long trough of polished silver chrome metal with a soft blue-grey shade (no brown soil left), and put a small clear pale glass dome with one white highlight over every vegetable plant. Keep the green vegetable plants, the three rows, the empty transparent gaps between them, the outline and the art style exactly the same.
